text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my♪ Thank you so much, Taishin-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Also. Just so you know, I left a 
present for you in your room."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, don't get so emotional... It's just a 
plain, ordinary soap set. Ordinary... or 
maybe even kind of lame.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! I'll be sure to treasure and 
use it♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Still... is that so? For my sake, 
Taishin-chan went and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've grown so big before I even realized 
it... To me, that is the greatest present 
of all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait. Today's supposed to be the day 
Creek-san grew a year older, right...?"
